title: GTA 6's Movie and TV Easter Eggs Nod to Dexter and Terminator
excerpt:
The game's world contains recognizable pop-culture references.
Players have connected several details to famous screen moments.
body_md:
Grand Theft Auto VI continues the franchise's tradition of borrowing visual language and playful details from movies and television. Players have highlighted several references that appear to evoke familiar scenes and characters, including the worlds of Dexter, Terminator 2 and The X-Files. Some are obvious homages; others remain interpretations made by fans.

One reported vehicle resembles the Mitsubishi Eclipse associated with Paul Walker's Brian O'Conner in the original Fast & Furious film. Another encounter recalls Terminator 2's memorable image of a shotgun concealed among roses. A location named Trinity Apartments and a collection of suspicious objects have also been connected by players to Dexter's Trinity Killer storyline.

Additional comparisons include a taxi encounter reminiscent of Michael Mann's Collateral and an alien-themed moment invoking the phrase associated with The X-Files. These discoveries are part of the pleasure of exploring a detailed open world, although not every resemblance should be treated as a formally confirmed reference by the developers. Which screen-inspired discovery would you look for first?
